articles.title: Supercooled kidneys have been transplanted into pigs in a “landmark achievement”
articles.summary:
Researchers have achieved a significant milestone in organ transplantation by successfully transplanting supercooled kidneys into pigs. Traditionally, donor organs deteriorate rapidly after removal, leaving surgeons a narrow window of a few hours to complete the transplant before the organ becomes unusable. By utilizing supercooling techniques, scientists can extend the viability of organs, potentially solving the critical time-constraint issue that currently leads to many viable organs being discarded. This breakthrough addresses a primary bottleneck in transplant medicine: the logistical challenge of transporting organs across long distances. If successfully translated to human medicine, this technology could drastically increase the pool of available organs and improve patient outcomes by allowing for more precise donor-recipient matching and optimized logistical coordination.
[**MIT Technology Review**](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/23/1140765/supercooled-kidneys-have-been-transplanted-into-pigs-in-a-landmark-achievement/)

articles.title: How AI helps scientists design the next generation of medicines
articles.summary:
The pharmaceutical industry faces systemic inefficiencies characterized by exorbitant R&D costs and high attrition rates during clinical trials. The integration of artificial intelligence is fundamentally transforming the design of biologic medicines—therapies derived from engineered proteins rather than traditional synthetic chemistry. By leveraging deep learning and generative models, researchers can now predict protein folding and optimize molecular structures with unprecedented precision. This shift reduces the reliance on trial-and-error experimentation, significantly shortening the development lifecycle and lowering the financial risk associated with drug discovery. As AI-driven platforms move from theoretical research to practical application, the industry is poised for a transition toward more personalized and effective therapeutic interventions, potentially unlocking treatments for previously intractable diseases while optimizing capital allocation within biotech portfolios.
[**MIT Technology Review**](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/23/1140346/how-ai-helps-scientists-design-the-next-generation-of-medicines/)

articles.title: Now, defenders are embracing the prompt injection, too
articles.summary:
Cybersecurity strategies are evolving to counter the rise of autonomous hacking agents by utilizing the same vulnerabilities these agents exploit. A technique known as "context bombing" leverages prompt injection to disrupt the operational logic of malicious AI agents. By flooding the agent's context window with contradictory or overwhelming instructions, defenders can effectively trick the AI into shutting down or deviating from its attack path before it can execute harmful actions. This shift represents a strategic pivot from traditional perimeter defense to active manipulation of the adversary's cognitive process. As AI-driven threats become more sophisticated, the ability to weaponize the inherent instability of Large Language Models (LLMs) against the attackers provides a critical layer of defense in the ongoing arms race between AI-powered offensive and defensive security tools.
[**Ars Technica AI**](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/now-defenders-are-embracing-the-prompt-injection-too/)

articles.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
articles.summary:
OpenAI has launched "Presence," an enterprise-grade AI agent platform designed to facilitate the deployment of voice and chat agents for both customer-facing and internal organizational workflows. This move signals OpenAI's strategic shift toward providing comprehensive infrastructure for autonomous agents, moving beyond simple chat interfaces to integrated operational tools. By focusing on "trusted" agents, the company is addressing critical enterprise concerns regarding reliability, security, and governance in AI deployments. Presence aims to streamline how businesses automate complex tasks, potentially reducing operational overhead while enhancing user experience through multimodal interaction. This launch positions OpenAI to compete more directly with enterprise automation platforms and specialized AI agent startups, leveraging its frontier models to offer a seamless, scalable agentic ecosystem for the corporate sector.
[**OpenAI Blog**](https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence)

articles.title: Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API:  background tasks, remote MCP and more
articles.summary:
Google has expanded the capabilities of Managed Agents within the Gemini API, introducing critical infrastructure for autonomous AI workflows. The update introduces support for background tasks, enabling agents to execute long-running processes asynchronously without requiring a persistent client connection. Furthermore, the integration of remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) allows agents to connect to external data sources and tools via a standardized interface, significantly reducing the friction associated with custom integrations. These enhancements transition Gemini from a reactive conversational model to a proactive agentic framework capable of managing complex, multi-step operations. By decoupling execution from the immediate request-response cycle and standardizing tool connectivity, Google is positioning Gemini to better compete in the enterprise automation space, where reliability and asynchronous processing are essential for production-grade AI deployments.
[**Google AI Blog**](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/expanding-managed-agents-gemini-api/)

articles.title: Accelerating the frontiers of scientific discovery: Google’s $40M commitment to the Genesis Mission
articles.summary:
Google has announced a $40 million commitment to the Genesis Mission, providing AI tokens and credits to accelerate scientific discovery. This initiative is designed to lower the barrier for researchers to utilize high-compute AI models when tackling complex scientific challenges. By providing these resources, Google aims to foster a collaborative ecosystem where AI can be applied to critical breakthroughs in fields such as biology, chemistry, and physics. This strategic move reflects a broader industry trend of major technology firms subsidizing compute for academic and independent research to ensure their infrastructure remains the standard for scientific innovation. The commitment underscores the critical role of compute availability in the current AI-driven research paradigm, positioning Google as a primary facilitator of next-generation scientific exploration.
[**DeepMind Blog**](https://deepmind.google/blog/accelerating-the-frontiers-of-scientific-discovery-googles-40m-commitment-to-the-genesis-mission/)

articles.title: Our approach to bioresilience
articles.summary:
Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs have outlined a strategic framework for "bioresilience," leveraging advanced AI models to anticipate and mitigate biological threats. The initiative focuses on accelerating the discovery of countermeasures against emerging pathogens and enhancing the global capacity to respond to pandemics. By integrating structural biology with predictive AI, the collaboration aims to shorten the timeline between the identification of a novel threat and the development of effective vaccines or therapeutics. This approach emphasizes a proactive rather than reactive stance on global health security, utilizing high-throughput computational modeling to simulate viral evolution and protein interactions. The partnership underscores the critical intersection of frontier AI and biotechnology in safeguarding public health against both natural and synthetic biological risks.
[**DeepMind Blog**](https://deepmind.google/blog/our-approach-to-bioresilience/)

articles.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
articles.summary:
FlowEvo introduces a training-free framework designed to enhance the capabilities of Large Language Model (LLM) agents by enabling them to retain and reuse successful problem-solving procedures. Unlike traditional agents where successful workflows are transient, FlowEvo compiles these traces into a persistent "skill bank" consisting of callable artifacts and structured guidance. The system operates via a continuous loop of workflow-to-skill compilation, skill-to-workflow feedback, and rigorous curation to prevent negative transfer. Empirical results demonstrate significant performance gains, particularly in interactive environments like ALFWorld, where it achieved an 82.8% success rate—outperforming the strongest baseline by 23.6 percentage points. Notably, the framework optimizes operational efficiency, reducing average token usage per episode by more than half compared to existing efficient baselines, offering a scalable approach to agent evolution without the need for parameter updates.
[**arXiv AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21596)

articles.title: Securing Multimodal AI through Internal Information Decomposition
articles.summary:
Researchers have introduced FlowGuard, a lightweight inference-time framework designed to secure Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) against sophisticated cross-modal attacks. Traditional defenses often fail because adversaries distribute malicious intent across different modalities to evade unimodal safeguards. FlowGuard addresses this by monitoring internal multimodal consistency using "FlowVectors," derived from Partial Information Decomposition. This approach quantifies cross-modal redundancy, synergy, and modality-specific dominance to detect when fused multimodal predictions diverge from unimodal semantic evidence. In empirical tests, FlowGuard reduced Attack Success Rates from over 90% to under 15% for unseen attacks, while maintaining high utility with less than 3% loss and achieving up to a six-fold reduction in latency. This methodology shifts the defense paradigm from raw input inspection to the analysis of internal fusion processes.
[**arXiv AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21600)

articles.title: Transferable Latency Prediction for Fast LLM Screening on Heterogeneous Edge Devices
articles.summary:
Researchers have developed a runtime-aware latency prediction framework designed to optimize the deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) across heterogeneous edge devices. The framework addresses the volatility of inference latency caused by hardware utilization, thermal variations, and dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS). By separating inference into prefill and decode phases and utilizing a gated prediction model that fuses static descriptors with dynamic hardware telemetry, the system achieves high accuracy in latency forecasting. Empirical tests on Pixel mobile devices and various GPU platforms demonstrate significant improvements in R-squared values, particularly in prefill-latency prediction. Furthermore, the framework supports cross-device transfer through lightweight calibration, substantially reducing the profiling overhead required to deploy models across diverse hardware environments, ranging from low-power Orange Pi boards to high-performance RTX 3090 GPUs.

[**arXiv AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21602)

articles.title: MotifRole-Diff: Risk-Optimal Role-Aware Corruption for Masked Molecular Graph Diffusion
articles.summary:
Researchers have introduced MotifRole-Diff, a novel approach to masked discrete diffusion for molecular graph generation that replaces uniform corruption schedules with role-aware strategies. Traditional models treat all tokens in a graph-to-sequence representation equally, ignoring the varying structural importance and reconstruction difficulty of different molecular components. MotifRole-Diff optimizes the allocation of a fixed masking budget by analyzing denoising difficulty and graph-level perturbation impact. This risk-optimal framework improves generation performance without altering the underlying model architecture or compute budget. Empirical results on the QM9 and MOSES datasets demonstrate significant gains in molecular validity and a reduction in Fréchet ChemNet Distance (FCD). These findings suggest that incorporating structural intelligence into corruption schedules is more effective than uniform masking for generating high-fidelity molecular graphs.
[**arXiv Machine Learning**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21634)

articles.title: U.S., other nations back open-source AI with 'strong security' at China summit
articles.summary:
The United States and other APEC member nations have reached a landmark agreement to support the development of open-source artificial intelligence, provided it is accompanied by rigorous security frameworks. This agreement, highlighted by China's industry and information technology minister Li Lecheng, marks the first time open-source cooperation has been formally addressed at the ministerial level within the APEC framework. The move suggests a strategic shift toward balancing the democratization of AI technology with the necessity of mitigating systemic risks and national security threats. By endorsing open-source models, these nations aim to foster global innovation and transparency while establishing guardrails to prevent misuse. This diplomatic alignment indicates a growing international consensus on the dual-use nature of AI and the need for collaborative governance to manage the tension between openness and security.
[**CNBC Finance**](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/china-ai-open-source-apec.html)

articles.title: Thomson Reuters and KKR Announce Joint Venture for Thomson Reuters Global Print Business
articles.summary:
Thomson Reuters has entered into a definitive agreement with KKR to establish a joint venture focused on its global print business. Under the terms of the transaction, Thomson Reuters will divest a 51% stake in the print division to KKR, the global investment firm. This strategic move allows Thomson Reuters to optimize its balance sheet and shift operational focus toward its core digital transformation and AI-driven professional services. For KKR, the venture represents a tactical acquisition of established print assets with steady cash flows. This partnership reflects a broader industry trend where legacy media and information providers carve out traditional print operations to unlock value and accelerate the transition to high-growth, software-as-a-service (SaaS) business models.
[**Reuters Business**](https://ir.thomsonreuters.com/news-releases/news-release-details/thomson-reuters-and-kkr-announce-joint-venture-thomson-reuters)

articles.title: Thomson Reuters Reports First-Quarter 2026 Results
articles.summary:
Thomson Reuters (TRI) has reported strong financial performance for the first quarter ending March 31, 2026, characterized by a 10% increase in total company revenues. Organic revenue growth reached 8% overall, with the company's "Big 3" segments—including Legal—demonstrating a slightly higher organic growth rate of 9%. These results indicate robust demand for the company's professional information services and a successful execution of its growth strategy across core business lines. The consistent growth in organic revenue suggests that Thomson Reuters is effectively leveraging its market position to expand its footprint and increase value delivery to its client base. This quarterly performance underscores the company's resilience and its ability to maintain upward momentum within the competitive professional data and legal services landscape.
[**Reuters Business**](https://ir.thomsonreuters.com/news-releases/news-release-details/thomson-reuters-reports-first-quarter-2026-results)

articles.title: Chinese chipmaker CXMT soars almost 500% in market debut
articles.summary:
ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), mainland China's leading memory chipmaker, experienced a massive market debut, with shares surging nearly 500%. This represents the largest initial public offering in the region since 2010, underscoring a significant appetite for domestic semiconductor assets. The surge is primarily driven by the critical role of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and DRAM in powering artificial intelligence workloads. As the US intensifies export controls on advanced chips, CXMT's growth highlights Beijing's strategic push for technological self-reliance. The valuation spike reflects investor confidence in China's ability to scale its domestic memory production to meet the escalating demands of AI infrastructure, despite ongoing geopolitical tensions and supply chain constraints. This event signals a pivotal moment for the Chinese semiconductor ecosystem's integration into global AI hardware trends.
[**Financial Times**](https://www.ft.com/content/8e82e939-908b-42bf-a314-0bb02a3f1b07?syn-25a6b1a6=1)

articles.title: Investors use crypto exchanges to avoid Chinese controls on AI stocks
articles.summary:
Investors are increasingly utilizing cryptocurrency exchanges to bypass stringent Chinese capital controls and restrictions on foreign access to domestic equity markets, specifically targeting high-growth AI stocks. By employing perpetual futures contracts—synthetic derivatives that track the price of an underlying asset without requiring ownership of the asset itself—market participants can gain leveraged exposure to Chinese AI firms while avoiding the regulatory hurdles associated with direct equity investment. This trend highlights a growing systemic gap where decentralized or offshore crypto-financial instruments are being used to circumvent national financial policies. The shift underscores the difficulty regulators face in enforcing capital controls in an era of digitized, borderless trading, potentially introducing new risks to market stability and regulatory oversight within the Chinese financial ecosystem.
[**Financial Times**](https://www.ft.com/content/af333b9c-d59d-4e7c-b814-12cef578895d?syn-25a6b1a6=1)

articles.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
articles.summary:
Reports indicate a surge in violence in the West Bank, where Israeli settlers have allegedly targeted mosques, vehicles, and agricultural land. These attacks follow a lethal confrontation near the village of Tal, which resulted in the deaths of four Palestinians and two Israelis. This pattern of arson and property destruction underscores the deteriorating security environment and the volatility of settler-Palestinian relations. From a geopolitical perspective, such escalations complicate diplomatic efforts to maintain stability in the region and increase the risk of wider conflict. The targeting of religious and economic infrastructure suggests a strategic intent to displace populations or exert territorial control through intimidation. This cycle of violence reflects a broader failure in local security governance and heightens the potential for further retaliatory strikes, further destabilizing the fragile regional status quo.
[**BBC World News**](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjrv77gl4deo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)

articles.title: U.S.-Iran War Pauses for 2nd Straight Day With Both Sides Holding Off on Strikes
articles.summary:
The conflict between the United States and Iran has entered a second consecutive day of operational pause, with both nations abstaining from further strikes. This strategic lull is attributed largely to logistical constraints within the U.S. military apparatus. American officials indicate that President Trump has deferred plans for further escalation primarily due to critical shortages in interceptor missile stockpiles. This depletion of defensive munitions limits the U.S. ability to sustain high-intensity engagements without risking significant vulnerabilities in regional air defense. The pause reflects a precarious balance where military necessity and resource scarcity are dictating the pace of geopolitical escalation. This development underscores the fragility of current defense supply chains and the direct impact of munitions availability on executive decision-making during active kinetic conflicts in the Middle East.
[**New York Times**](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/26/world/middleeast/us-iran-war-pause.html)
